verificationGate.health: GET /health proves PostgreSQL, JetStream, Ledger, integrity, and zero degraded state for the authorized source and release.
verificationGate.version: GET /version proves service, commit, release, and schema version.
verificationGate.metrics: GET /metrics proves the authoritative producer reaches Event, Outbox, Inbox, and Ledger effect without exposing sensitive dimensions.
verificationGate.producerBoundary: Only a product owner's already-authoritative outcome may emit a sanitized asynchronous event; a Data Fabric failure never gates standard Wallet connection.
verificationGate.publicTruth: No endpoint response, artifact, or dry run changes integratedCentral, deployedStaging, deployedPublic, downloadHosted, productionSigned, or storeReleased until Central records direct evidence.

centralActionRequired: Bind one authoritative public Data Fabric endpoint and complete runtime/service/current/rollback mapping, then issue one minimal writable lease with immutable input and receipt paths.
